values.expense_sustainability_how_we_calculate_:
In the emissions summary we’re showing you this years amount of kilograms that are related to your expenses, mileages and travels.

The numbers are based on all of your approved claims.

We also show you the increase or decrease percentage compared to the same period last year.

Why do we show this? In some cases, your company might want to reduce its amount of emissions. Information like this might give valuable insight to help with this reduction.

Our emissions calculator uses a large database of emissions data from our partners to estimate your emissions by using the type and amount. If you’re interested you can read more about our partners by following these links.
How do we calculate these emissions?
values.expense_sustainability_limitations_data_: The emissions report represents a significant step towards promoting sustainability and eco-conscious decision-making. However, it’s important to acknowledge that this feature does come with certain limitations.\nWe do not support calculating emissions for custom mileage types, snowmobiles or ATVs.\nWe do not calculate emissions for special allowances (e.g. compensation abroad), tax deductions (e.g. fuel benefits), or custom allowances.

values.faq_my_profile_answer_1: Tap the person icon in the top-right corner to open the Account manager. You\'ll see all accounts you\'ve added to the app. Tap the one you want to use. If an account shows \"Session expired\", you\'ll be asked to sign in again before it becomes active.
values.faq_my_profile_answer_2: Open the Account manager and tap + Add account at the bottom. You can keep several accounts signed in at the same time — useful if you work for more than one employer or have both a private and a work account.
values.faq_my_profile_answer_3: Personal information is managed by your employer\'s payroll system, not directly in the app. Open My profile to see your current details. To request a change, contact your HR or payroll administrator — once they update your record, the new information will sync to the app.
values.faq_my_profile_answer_4: Simply open the document. Once closed, a separate \"mark as read\" action will prompt. If selected, the document will be tagged as Read in the list.
values.faq_my_profile_answer_5: It estimates the CO₂ equivalent (CO₂e) generated by the expenses you\'ve reported this year — mainly travel-related items such as car mileage, road tolls and accommodation. The percentage at the top compares your current year against the same period last year.
values.faq_my_profile_answer_6: Emissions are estimated from the expense type and the amount or distance reported, using standard CO₂e conversion factors. Tap How do we calculate emissions at the bottom of the screen for the full methodology.
